actCode: "Shipper created a label, UPS has not received the package yet." Some replies send it with no clock.
actCode: "Drop-Off", the sender handed the parcel in at an access point.

actCode: "The UPS Access Point™ location has prepared the package for return to UPS or pickup by UPS." Seen right after a drop-off; UPS uses the same sentence when an uncollected parcel goes back, where the later scans decide the stage.
actCode: "Pickup Scan".

actCode: "We’re sorry your package was delayed. We are adjusting delivery plans as quickly as possible."
actCode: "UPS will be in your area and will deliver your package a day early."
actCode: UPS corrected the postal code and the parcel continues.
actCode: "The package has been redirected and forwarded to the delivery center."
actCode: a delivery change request, processed once the parcel is back at the facility.
actCode: the receiver asked for a temporary change of delivery address.
actCode: "Delivery to a UPS Access Point™ location is pending."
actCode: a UPS My Choice® delivery change was modified or cancelled.

actCode: "The package will be delivered to the UPS Access Point™ location requested by the receiver." A future instruction: the shared classifier read it as ready for pickup, but the parcel then went out for delivery.
actCode: "Package moving to local post office", Ground Saver's hand-off to the post office.
actCode: "Package transferred to post office", a Ground Saver parcel handed to USPS for the last leg. The reply then names its USPS number.
actCode: "Received by the local post office", after LX.
actCode: "Package has been received from UPS Access Point™ location. UPS will process as necessary."
actCode: the access point is closing; UPS collects its parcels and the receiver is contacted. Not available for pickup: the same scan says delivery to an alternate access point is pending.
actCode: "Loaded on Delivery Vehicle" or "Out For Delivery". UPS groups the first under its On the Way milestone, but the delivery followed the same day each time.
actCode: "Out For Delivery Today".
actCode: the receiver was not available; a second attempt follows.
actCode: the business was closed; a second attempt follows.
actCode: UPS could not deliver and is taking the parcel to an access point.
actCode: "Delivered to UPS Access Point™".
actCode: "UPS Access Point™ possession", right after 2Q. The shared classifier left it in transit.
